title: Batman's love interests
text: Batman's most enduring love interest is Catwoman, Selina Kyle. Others include Talia al Ghul, the mother of his son Damian, and the journalist Vicki Vale.

title: Others who have been Batman
text: Besides Bruce Wayne, the main comics have had Jean-Paul Valley (Azrael), Dick Grayson and James Gordon take over as Batman. Terry McGinnis is Batman in the future of Batman Beyond.
asks: Who replaced Bruce Wayne as Batman?
Has anyone other than Bruce Wayne been Batman?

title: The Batgirls
text: The main Batgirls, in order, are Barbara Gordon, Cassandra Cain and Stephanie Brown. Bette Kane was an earlier Bat-Girl in 1961.
